[P2] Return to design before adding the CLI alias

Rule 3, “Write a design note before the code,” explicitly covers new options. This adds `--test-args`, while the description declares the design note unnecessary because the addition is an alias. Preserving the old spelling does not exempt the new option from that rule. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and obtain agreement on the required note, including whether expanding the CLI belongs in this bug fix.
